title: New Places... Familiar Faces!
overview: Now that the Unova League is over, our heroes contemplate what the future holds, while a new friend helps them deal with a blast from the past!

title: The Name's N!
overview: On a ship heading to meet Professor Cedric Juniper at the White Ruins, our heroes are introduced to a young man with an unusual gift and an equally unusual point of view!

title: There's a New Gym Leader in Town!
overview: After arriving in Aspertia City at the request of Professor Juniper, our heroes pay a visit to one of the most unusual Gyms they've ever seen!

title: Team Plasma's Pokémon Power Plot!
overview: Continuing their journey to the White Ruins, our heroes encounter a mysterious organization with a sinister plot!

title: The Light of Floccesy Ranch!
overview: As our heroes continue their journey to the White Ruins, they come across a Mareep ranch with some fog and leadership issues!

title: Saving Braviary!
overview: Team Plasma is on the move, and so is N!

title: The Pokémon Harbor Patrol!
overview: Arriving in Virbank City, our heroes and N encounter another group of heroes with some surprising results!

title: The Fires of a Red-Hot Reunion!
overview: After discovering a festival celebrating the sights and sounds of the Kanto region, Ash reunites with an old friend, who shows what real staying power is all about!

title: Team Plasma's Pokémon Manipulation!
overview: Team Plasma is determined to execute its evil plans, but our heroes and N have other ideas!

title: Secrets from Out of the Fog!
overview: As our heroes continue their journey to the White Ruins, they learn startling secrets about N and Team Plasma!

title: Meowth, Colress and Team Rivalry!
overview: As Team Plasma's mission to control Pokémon continues, Team Rocket's mission takes aim at Team Plasma!

title: Ash and N: A Clash of Ideals!
overview: As our heroes unite with Professor Cedric Juniper at the White Ruins, it soon becomes obvious that they're not the only ones on a quest for information about Reshiram!

title: Team Plasma and the Awakening Ceremony!
overview: As Team Plasma's plan to steal the Light Stone unfolds, our heroes and their friends are doing everything they can to stop it!

title: What Lies Beyond Truth and Ideals!
overview: As the evil plan to control Reshiram continues to unfold, the survival of the world lies in Team Plasma's defeat. But can they be defeated?!
